method: Hand-authored revision of v001: warmer gold, more saturated violet gradients, explicit curved edge highlights, smaller glints and reduced grey-blue wash. Development-only resvg-py 0.5.0 / resvg 0.48.1, explicit --revision v002, 2x export. Genuine Unreal sRGB UI texture import, bilinear, no mips/streaming. No imagegen or supplied-reference pixel extraction/editing.
native: Same full export UVs, nine-slice margins .145 horizontal / .45 vertical and responsive reference slot beneath live label/star/native button. Geometry, text and production input/learning handlers unchanged.

fallback_chain.native: ordinary live fill/outline, label and separate star

limits: Eight fixed opaque-face samples improve locally but are not a whole-material metric. Bevel/gold/gloss/texture still differ from reference. Full UI01, motion, device, manual accessibility, editorial, isolated offline, performance and release gates remain open.
